app.name: en: A11yFred
app.tagline: en: Your AI-second helper for manual accessibility auditing and reporting.
common.sponsored_body: en: Receive ads from companies in the accessibility and developer communities. Your privacy is respected, no tracking, no profiles, no algorithms.
onboarding.heading: en: Welcome to A11yFred
onboarding.welcome_body: en: Your AI-second helper for manual accessibility auditing and reporting.
onboarding.confirm_body: en: You have not reached the end of the tour. Close now and skip the rest?
onboarding.slide_1_body: en: Describe what you observed: a component name, symptom, or WCAG success criterion. Use the Platform and WCAG Level filters to narrow the corpus. Use Narrow Results to filter within what is already showing. Results are sorted by relevance, then by severity.
onboarding.slide_2_body: en: Use Rank Up/Down to rank results by importance. Star a entry to always show it first. Pin a entry to keep it at the top across all searches.
onboarding.slide_3_body: en: Open a entry to see its title, WCAG criterion, description, and suggested fix. Add a location prefix to the description (e.g. 'Global:'). Use AI Assist to revise any field using your notes, then copy fields individually or use Copy All to grab everything at once.

help.take_tour_description: en: Replay the onboarding tour to revisit how A11yFred works.
help.step_1_body: en: Results appear as you type. Use the Platform filter in Settings to choose Web or Native App entries (most are web-focused). Use +term to require a word and -term to exclude one (e.g. keyboard +screen reader -wcag2.2).
help.step_2_body: en: Each result has Rank Up and Rank Down buttons to change how it ranks. Star a result to make it always appear first. Pin any result to keep it at the top across all searches.
help.step_3_body: en: Select the entry that best matches what you observed. Results are sorted by relevance first, then by severity.
help.step_4_body: en: Add a location prefix to the description (e.g. 'Global:' or 'Cart:'). If AI Assist is on, add your notes to the Revision Notes field and AI will rewrite the entry to match your context.
help.step_5_body: en: Copy the description and suggested fix into your spreadsheet or report. Use Copy All to grab both fields at once.
help.shortcuts_note: en: Shortcuts are only active when focus is on the result list. Use them to quickly navigate and rate entries without leaving the list.
help.shortcut_rank_up: en: Shift + ↑ = Rank up current result
help.shortcut_rank_down: en: Shift + ↓ = Rank down current result
about.what_body: en: This is a library of accessibility entries for manual audits. Search for what you observed, find a description that fits, and copy it into your report.
about.what_body_2_prefix: en: The same issues come up on almost every site. This tool keeps your descriptions consistent across reports so you are not writing from scratch each time. The library was built from real audit work, then refined with AI for plain language, consistency, accuracy, and fact-checking against
about.what_wcag: en: This data covers WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA, the standard used by most organizations and the basis for many legal accessibility requirements. A small number of Level AAA Success Criteria are also included where the accessibility community broadly considers the failure pattern significant.
about.feature_ai_body: en: Use AI to rewrite a entry based on your notes. Bring your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google. It stays in your browser and is never sent to us. Set it up in
about.feature_agentic_body: en: If you use Claude (Anthropic), you can also enable Match Existing Style. The AI will search past revision examples to match the tone and depth you have already established, not just rewrite the current entry in isolation.
about.feature_languages_body: en: This library is available in 65 languages including RTL support for right-to-left languages. I have a love and fascination for language, culture, and linguistics. Adding all of these languages was a side quest, part-experiment, part-rabbit hole, part-losing the plot for a bit. The translations were AI-generated and some are incomplete, so please bear that in mind. Mistakes are expected, especially for technical accessibility terms. Corrections welcome. Switch in
about.feature_pinning_label: en: Pinning, Starring, Ranking, Archiving, Filtering, Sorting
about.feature_pinning_body: en: Pin any entry to keep it at the top across all searches. Star a entry to always show it first in ranked results. Use Rank Up and Rank Down to fine-tune sort order within severity. Archive a entry to push it to the bottom and visually dim it. Filter by platform, WCAG version, or conformance level using the badge filters. Sort by severity, title, WCAG criterion, or Smart order which combines severity with your personal ranking.
about.feature_a11y_body: en: Built to WCAG 2.2. Includes focus management, live regions, full keyboard navigation, reduced motion support, and high-contrast color tokens.
about.sources_body: en: The base corpus was built from real audit work across dozens of manual audits. AI was used to improve language clarity, cross-entry consistency, accuracy, source citation formatting, and WCAG Success Criterion alignment. Each entry is written in plain language and tied to a specific WCAG Success Criterion where one applies.

settings.privacy_body_1: en: Everything is stored locally in your browser using localStorage. Nothing personal is sent to us or any server. Anonymous page view analytics are collected via Umami (no cookies, no personal data, no user tracking). Stored data includes: theme, language, platform filter, WCAG filter, Live Search setting, ranking controls visibility, personal entries visibility, AI provider preference, AI model selection, agentic mode setting, API keys, entry ratings, pinned entries, per-entry notes, recent entries, custom entries, personal corpus edits, co-selection pairs, pending contribution suggestions, your last opened entry, settings save count, onboarding status, and View All preference.
settings.privacy_body_2: en: API keys are stored in your browser only and sent directly to the AI provider you have configured. We never see or receive them. You can remove them at any time from the AI settings below, or by clearing your browser's site data for this page.
settings.privacy_body_translations: en: UI translations and the base public corpus were translated using AI. Some translations are incomplete and errors are expected. No user-entered data, custom entries, or personal edits are ever sent for translation.
